data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Alaia means 'nourishing' or 'nurturing'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ala', which means 'nourish' or 'feed'. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Ala is a form of Kali, the goddess of creation and destruction. She is believed to provide nourishment and protection to her devotees. The name Alaia carries the meaning “Nourishing, Nurturing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Alaia usually hope their child will grow to embody nourishing, nurturing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
